subject: English
passage: Tariq Mansour, who was the first to map the overland caravan route from Damascus to Samarkand in the medieval period, and Nattaya Ishikawa, who was the first to catalog the royal correspondence archive of the Ayutthaya court, are ensured lasting places in our historical memory. No matter what scholars may accomplish in the future, nobody can ever ______ the standing of these pioneers as the first to complete these undertakings.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation: Choice A is the best answer. In this context, 'undermine' means to weaken or diminish. The passage states that Tariq Mansour and Nattaya Ishikawa have lasting places in historical memory because they were the first to accomplish their respective feats, and emphasizes that no matter what future scholars do, their pioneering status cannot be altered. This logic supports the idea that nobody can undermine, or weaken, their standing as the first to complete these undertakings.
